policy.resampling: nearest-neighbor, identical uniform transform at1024 and256
policy.proportions: Cats measured by cheek width and paw soles; people by crown-to-sole height and face width; remaining species compared by body mass and footprint.
policy.placement: Cats share paw baseline218; people share sole baseline230; other pets centered128,128. Body landmarks exclude decorative extensions.
policy.approvals: Keep owner-approved black-bow cursive Patty and the owner-selected second-to-last Unicorn.
policy.private: Claude Bot and Skill Scout stay local only.
policy.runtime: Review exports only; no runtime adoption. Separate PR268 scale must be reconciled before live integration.
